signals.title: Towards Robust Partial-Edit Deepfake Localization: An edit and Generator Conditioned Analysis
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.26903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Partial-edit deepfake localization aims to identify manipulated regions within otherwise authentic speech. Recent systems report strong overall results, but aggregate scores do not reveal whether this performance holds across different editing conditions. In this work, we present an edit- and generator-conditioned analysis of Segment-Aware Localization (SAL) using WavLM-Large and XLS-R representations on the VoiceCraft and SSR-Speech subsets of PartialEdit. We categorize edits along three transcript-derived axes, namely content, meaning change, and editing operation, and evaluate each generator separately. While both representations achieve strong overall performance, localization is noticeably weaker on SSR-Speech. From our experiments, we found that the deletion is the hardest operation, and deletions produced by SSR-Speech are the most challenging condition for both representations. In contrast, edit content, meaning change, and sentence novelty have smaller effects. signals.title: Keep the Process, Change the Supplier: Runtime Governance for Tool-Using AI Agents
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.26966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using AI agents propose actions whose authorization and external effects cannot be inferred from generated text alone. We study an execution boundary that separates agent proposals from business-controlled authority, context disclosure, and supplier selection. The Open Process Control Plane (OPCP) mediates capability calls and records uncertain outcomes when a supplier may have acted without returning an acceptable reply. We evaluate this runtime with scripted requests and synthetic suppliers: 2,400 fault episodes across four policies, 60 process-termination/restart episodes, 19,000 timed calls across 19 configurations, five targeted mutations over 43 fixtures, and 160 substitution records. No language model or autonomous agent is evaluated. OPCP and a conservative composition agree on all measured fault outcomes. Both recover after definite refusal without cross-supplier duplication; retry-all duplicates effects in every tested lost-reply-after-commit case. signals.title: On the loss landscape of the linear neural network: beyond critical points
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.26671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While the critical points of the loss landscape in linear neural networks have been extensively studied since the seminal work of Baldi \& Hornik in the late 1980s, a description of this landscape at an intermediate or global scale is still lacking. Such a characterization is crucial, particularly as a substantial body of literature indicates that gradient descent circumvents critical points. The present article introduces an intermediate structure, termed the critical thalweg, which encompasses all critical points and exhibits key geometric properties. Beyond providing a geometric proof of Baldi \& Hornik's results using simpler assumptions than the existing literature, this framework offers a global view of the loss landscape that can be easily visualized in a two-dimensional plane. Empirical observations suggest that gradient descent is attracted toward the critical thalweg, along which the loss continues to decrease to its global minimum.

signals.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
signals.summary: Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years. Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. themes.reading: Các diễn biến chính trị và thương mại có thể ảnh hưởng đến vận tải, giá đầu vào hoặc quyết định đầu tư. Chưa thể suy ra tác động tới Việt Nam nếu chưa biết tuyến hàng, mặt hàng và mức độ phơi nhiễm.

themes.title: Việt Nam: chính sách và điều kiện kinh doanh
themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu không có văn bản/số liệu gốc hoặc nội dung không tạo thay đổi đáng kể với doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Kinh tế bạc - cơ hội từ 16,5 triệu người cao tuổi
evidence.summary: Với gần 16,5 triệu người từ 60 tuổi trở lên, Việt Nam định hướng phát triển kinh tế bạc trên nhiều lĩnh vực, vừa mở rộng thị trường sản phẩm, dịch vụ, vừa phát huy sức lao động, kinh nghiệm và trí tuệ của người cao tuổi để tạo động lực tăng trưởng.

evidence.title: Tỷ giá trung tâm lập kỷ lục mới
evidence.summary: Tỷ giá trung tâm hôm nay tăng 9 đồng, lên mức kỷ lục mới, trong khi giá USD tại các ngân hàng thương mại tăng hơn 300 đồng sau hai tuần, vượt 26.000 đồng.

evidence.title: 7 thành viên mới của Trung tâm tài chính quốc tế TP HCM dự kiến huy động 5 tỷ USD
evidence.summary: Dragon Capital, Mekong Capital, quỹ đầu tư Singapore CMIA Capital Partners là ba trong 7 thành viên mới của VIFC-HCMC, dự kiến huy động 5 tỷ USD giai đoạn 2027-2030.

evidence.title: DNSE: AI định hình phương thức đầu tư mới
evidence.summary: AI giúp các cá nhân tiếp cận các công cụ phân tích chuyên sâu, xây dựng chiến lược phù hợp, từng bước thu hẹp khoảng cách với nhà đầu tư tổ chức, theo Chủ tịch DNSE.
